items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that ease open to their height while the content fades up behind, one at a time or several, with full keyboard support.

items.name: activity-log
items.title: Activity Log
items.description: An audit log grouped by day, with live search and filters by person and event type.

items.name: ai-blob
items.title: AI Blob
items.description: A 3D dotted orb for AI states. Click to morph between five shapes.

items.name: ai-orb
items.title: AI Orb
items.description: A glass assistant orb filled with a living mesh gradient of shades that rests, listens, thinks and speaks, reacting to a live voice level.

items.name: amount-pad
items.title: Amount Pad
items.description: A money field where each digit drops in and lands, commas slide into place as the number grows, the amount shrinks to fit, and a digit past the limit bounces off in red.

items.name: anagram-shuffle
items.title: Anagram Shuffle
items.description: Letters rearrange themselves into the next anagram.

items.name: animated-tabs
items.title: Animated Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose underline or pill springs between tabs, with a highlight that follows the pointer, panels that slide in from the direction you moved and a panel area that eases to each panel's height.

items.name: announcement-pill
items.title: Announcement Pill
items.description: A small New pill for above a hero heading, with a band of light along its border and an arrow that grows on hover.

items.name: apple-keyboard
items.title: Apple Keyboard
items.description: A Magic Keyboard drawn in CSS that mirrors your typing, with keys that sink into their wells and synthesised scissor-switch sounds.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: A time-series chart with soft area washes and one crosshair that reads every series at once.

items.name: ascii-field
items.title: ASCII Field
items.description: A slow field of light drawn as type, glyphs thickening where it brightens; the pointer brings a lens that reshuffles them.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Slow curtains of light with fine rays that lean toward the cursor.

items.name: auth-forms
items.title: Auth Forms
items.description: Sign in, sign up, code verification and password reset in one card that eases between modes.

items.name: avatar-stack
items.title: Avatar Stack
items.description: Overlapping avatars that fan on hover and spring apart into a named list on a card growing out of the row.

items.name: balloon-button
items.title: Balloon Button
items.description: An inflated, half-balloon button drawn with a WebGL shader, with folds along its seam and a springy dent when pressed.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar List
items.description: A ranked list of top pages, referrers or countries whose rows slide to their new rank and resize when you switch lists.

items.name: beam-network
items.title: Beam Network
items.description: Nodes joined by curved lines with a beam of light that runs from start to end, for any shape of connection.

items.name: blob-selector
items.title: Blob Selector
items.description: A segmented control whose pill pours like liquid between options, stretching and thinning as it travels, with press-and-drag scrubbing.

items.name: blur-reveal
items.title: Blur Reveal
items.description: Letters sharpen out of a blur, one after another.

items.name: boarding-pass
items.title: Boarding Pass
items.description: A ticket whose stub you pull off: the perforation gives one paper bridge at a time, in WebGL, leaving a fibrous edge and a checked-in mark.

items.name: bookmark-button
items.title: Bookmark Button
items.description: A save button whose bookmark fills from the top like a dropped ribbon while the label rolls to Saved.

items.name: cart-flight
items.title: Cart Flight
items.description: A product grid where added items fly on a curve into the cart, the cart grows into a drawer, and removed items fly back to their card.

items.name: caustics
items.title: Caustics
items.description: Sunlight on a pool floor, from light rays bent by moving water; click to drop a ripple.

items.name: classic-navbar
items.title: Classic Navbar
items.description: A full-width bar that hides while you scroll down and returns on scroll up, with an underline that slides to the current page. Links left, centred or right; zero to two CTAs.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code block that shows plain text at once and colours it in place with on-demand Shiki, with tabs that sync across blocks, marked lines, diffs, collapsing and a copy button.

items.name: collapsible-sidebar
items.title: Collapsible Sidebar
items.description: An app sidebar that folds to an icon rail with the icons staying put, tooltips in the rail and a sliding highlight; ⌘B toggles it.

items.name: collapsing-breadcrumb
items.title: Collapsing Breadcrumb
items.description: A breadcrumb that folds its middle crumbs into an ellipsis when space runs out and unfolds them in place on hover or tap, each crumb sliding open to its own width.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A calm ⌘K command menu: fuzzy and server search, grouped results, nested pages, recents, hotkeys and full keyboard control, with optional filter pills.

items.name: company-card
items.title: Company Card
items.description: A business card rendered as a real 3D slab in WebGL: foil and holographic logos, diffraction, glitter, lenticular and pearl finishes, and a pattern seeded by the company name, all lit by the pointer as the card tilts.

items.name: compare-slider
items.title: Compare Slider
items.description: A before-and-after frame that sweeps in on first view, with a smooth draggable divider, keyboard support and labels that step aside.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: A menu that opens where you right-click or long-press, with submenus, checkable items and full keyboard control.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: A copy button whose two sheets slide together into a check while the label rolls to Copied.

items.name: crumble-to-sand
items.title: Crumble to Sand
items.description: The phrase crumbles into grains that rebuild the next one.

items.name: deploy-pipeline
items.title: Deploy Pipeline
items.description: A deploy card that runs itself: steps spin and check off down a filling rail, then the card turns Ready with the live URL.

items.name: diagonal-beams
items.title: Diagonal Beams
items.description: One soft light falling across sharp, slanted pleats in the dark, its edge dissolving into fine grain.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal that grows out of the button that opened it, holds focus, and eases back when another dialog opens on top.

items.name: dither-gradient
items.title: Dither Gradient
items.description: A bending gradient drawn only in your colours through an ordered dither.

items.name: domino-letters
items.title: Domino Letters
items.description: Letters topple one into the next like dominoes.

items.name: dot-grid
items.title: Dot Grid
items.description: A quiet grid of dots lit by a drifting wave and by the cursor.

items.name: dotted-globe
items.title: Dotted Globe
items.description: A turning globe of dotted land in five modes: arcs flying between cities, people coming online, pulses of activity, routes with travelling packets, and labelled locations. Drag to spin it.

items.name: draggable-letters
items.title: Draggable Letters
items.description: Letters you can pull apart; they spring home.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: A menu with icons, shortcuts, checkbox and radio items and submenus, a sliding highlight and full keyboard control.

items.name: elastic-slider
items.title: Elastic Slider
items.description: A slider that stretches like rubber past its ends and springs back.

items.name: email-composer
items.title: Email Composer
items.description: An email composer with recipient chips and suggestions, contact cards on hover, drag-and-drop attachments with upload progress, and a send button that schedules.

items.name: event-feed
items.title: Event Feed
items.description: A live feed card where new events drop in at the top with a soft highlight, push the rest down and age in real time.

items.name: expand-button
items.title: Expand Button
items.description: An icon-only button that springs open to reveal its label on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: fade-left-to-right
items.title: Fade In Left to Right
items.description: A soft-edged mask reveals the text from left to right.

items.name: falling-letters
items.title: Falling Letters
items.description: Letters drop in and settle with a small bounce.

items.name: ferrofluid-menu
items.title: Ferrofluid Menu
items.description: A glossy drop of ferrofluid that grows spikes toward the pointer, then pours out droplets that spread into a menu.

items.name: file-card
items.title: File Card
items.description: A document card whose corner curls on hover to show the next page, with older versions stacked behind the sheet.

items.name: filter-grid
items.title: Filter Grid
items.description: Tabs over a grid of tiles that can sit in several tabs: tiles in both glide to their new places, leaving ones blur away, newcomers grow in one by one, and the grid's height eases to fit.

items.name: flaming-todos
items.title: Flaming Todos
items.description: A todo list where finished items burn away in WebGL flames.

items.name: fold-tabs
items.title: Fold Tabs
items.description: Tabs that fold into an accordion when their container gets narrow, with the track, the active pill and every label carried across so the switch reads as one object changing shape.

items.name: fold-toolbar
items.title: Fold Toolbar
items.description: An icon button that unfolds into a tray of tools, pushing its neighbours aside, and folds back into whichever tool you pick.

items.name: folder-faq
items.title: Folder FAQ
items.description: An FAQ laid out as files in a drawer: each question peeks out on its tab, and opening one lifts it from the stack while the folders in front slide down to uncover the answer.

items.name: folder-peek
items.title: Folder Peek
items.description: A folder whose file previews rise and fan out on hover, fly out into a list when opened, and that takes files dropped onto it.

items.name: gauge-dial
items.title: Gauge Dial
items.description: A 240-degree dial whose gradient arc fills behind a spring-driven knob, with lit ticks and a zone badge; drag it or use the arrow keys.

items.name: grain-gradient
items.title: Grain Gradient
items.description: Colour that folds slowly like silk, finished with film grain.

items.name: halftone
items.title: Halftone
items.description: A screen of lit dots: swirling ribbons of light drawn by the size and brightness of each dot.

items.name: halftone-horizon
items.title: Halftone Horizon
items.description: An arched horizon printed in halftone in the dark, where the dots grow with the light until they fuse into a smooth glow.

items.name: hamburger-sheet
items.title: Hamburger Sheet
items.description: A menu button that grows into its own sheet: the shape unfolds from the button's corner while the three lines cross into the close mark.

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: A marker stroke sweeps across a key phrase.

items.name: hold-to-confirm
items.title: Hold to Confirm
items.description: A destructive-action button that has to be held down; a fill grows across it and drains back if released early.

items.name: horizon-gradient
items.title: Horizon Gradient
items.description: Black fading through deep blue to white in bands that arch like a horizon, breathing slowly.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: A preview card that opens while you rest on a link and stays while you move into it, so its own links work.

items.name: hover-weight
items.title: Hover Weight
items.description: Letters grow heavier as the cursor nears them.

items.name: ink-plume
items.title: Ink Plume
items.description: A soft plume of black ink rising through white, split at its edges into ultramarine and vermilion, spreading to a haze as it climbs.

items.name: inline-confirm
items.title: Inline Confirm
items.description: A destructive button that splits into Cancel and Confirm in its own footprint, so nothing around it moves.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline Edit
items.description: A label that opens into an input in place, with save and cancel sliding out from its edge, then folds back to the new value.

items.name: integration-orbit
items.title: Integration Orbit
items.description: Your logo at the centre of two slow rings of app icons; pointing at one stops the rings, draws a line to the middle and names the app.

items.name: jiggle-grid
items.title: Jiggle Grid
items.description: A home-screen grid you rearrange like on a phone: hold a tile and they all wobble, drag one and the rest spring aside to make room.

items.name: kpi-tile
items.title: KPI Tile
items.description: A dashboard stat with its change and a sparkline you can scrub, rolling the number to any day.

items.name: large-title-header
items.title: Large Title Header
items.description: A large page title that rides up with the content and docks into the top bar as you scroll, moving and scaling as one piece, with the bar filling in behind it.

items.name: lean-scramble
items.title: Lean and Scramble
items.description: Words lean and scramble under the cursor.

items.name: light-badge
items.title: Light Badge
items.description: A badge lit from below by a rotating gradient stroke and soft rays.

items.name: light-rain
items.title: Light Rain
items.description: Thin lines of blue light falling through the dark, with bright glints sliding along them.

items.name: light-stream
items.title: Light Stream
items.description: An hourglass of fine iridescent light streaks with glittering dust, flowing through the dark.

items.name: line-rise
items.title: Line-by-line Rise
items.description: Each wrapped line rises into place in turn.

items.name: liquid-progress
items.title: Liquid Progress
items.description: A simple progress bar with a liquid feel: tones of one colour that brighten as it fills, a soft shine, and a front that settles with a small wobble.

items.name: live-cursors
items.title: Live Cursors
items.description: A shared document where three teammates' cursors select, type and drag a card at their own pace, to show real-time collaboration.

items.name: loading-shimmer
items.title: Loading Shimmer
items.description: A light sweep across text while something loads.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An endless, seamless row of logos, quotes or tags that slows on hover and fades out at the edges.

items.name: mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh Gradient
items.description: Six drifting points of colour melting into each other along soft, curling seams.

items.name: mitosis-menu
items.title: Mitosis Menu
items.description: A round button that divides like a cell: each option buds off on a stretching neck of liquid that snaps, then fuses back in when the menu closes.

items.name: morphing-popover
items.title: Morphing Popover
items.description: A button that grows into a panel by springing its real size and corners, so nothing stretches, then folds back into the button.

items.name: nested-sidebar
items.title: Nested Sidebar
items.description: A sidebar for deep navigation: items open in place beside a guide line, search (press /) filters the tree, and it folds to a rail of top-level icons.

items.name: notification-center
items.title: Notification Center
items.description: A bell with an unread count that opens every notification in one panel: grouped by day, marked read as you open them, cleared one at a time or all at once.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: Notifications that pile up as panes of frosted glass, fan out on hover and blur away when swiped.

items.name: oil-slick
items.title: Oil Slick
items.description: Light on a film of oil over dark water, folding slowly through blue, gold and coral, shot on grainy film.

items.name: on-this-page
items.title: On This Page
items.description: A section outline where a dot rides a rail with your scroll, subsections fold open as you reach them, and clicking jumps to a section.

items.name: org-chart
items.title: Org Chart
items.description: A pan-and-zoom org chart whose teams grow out of and fold back into their manager, with search that flies to a person, a minimap and profile cards.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time code field whose boxes merge and scramble into a pass or fail result.

items.name: outline-fill
items.title: Outline then Fill
items.description: Letters are drawn as outlines, then filled in.

items.name: page-indicator
items.title: Page Indicator
items.description: Pagination dashes you can click, scrub, step with arrows or type into.

items.name: paper-shredder
items.title: Paper Shredder
items.description: Drag a document into the slot and the motor pulls it through, out into strips that sway, drop and crumple onto the pile.

items.name: particle-logo
items.title: Particle Logo
items.description: A logo made of dots that gather in from across the frame, part around the pointer like sand and spring back, and scatter outward on a press.

items.name: particle-scatter
items.title: Particle Scatter
items.description: Each press breaks the phrase into particles that regroup.

items.name: pixel-bot
items.title: Pixel Bot
items.description: A tiny pixel face that cycles through animated expressions.

items.name: pixel-burst
items.title: Pixel Burst
items.description: Square pixels burst from the centre or the edges in a checkerboard that pales into loose, flickering pixels, with a ring pulsing out now and then.

items.name: plucked-curve
items.title: Plucked Curve
items.description: Text rides a curve that wobbles like a plucked string.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel that grows out of its button, flips when there's no room, and keeps its arrow pointed at the button.

items.name: pricing-receipt
items.title: Pricing Receipt
items.description: Pick a plan and a receipt prints with the line items and total due today, then gets stamped.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Progress as a bar, a ring, a segmented breakdown and a list of steps. Values ease on a spring so fast updates never stutter, numbers roll, and finishing draws a check.

items.name: progress-dots
items.title: Progress Dots
items.description: Pagination dots where the active one stretches into a pill that fills as it plays, and the row opens into labelled steps on hover. Also comes as full-width story segments.

items.name: project-dashboard
items.title: Project Dashboard
items.description: A team overview with cycle progress, issues by status, workload per person, recently updated issues and an activity feed.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: An AI prompt box that grows as you type, with file attachments, a model picker, slash commands, @mentions, a send button that turns into stop, and voice dictation whose words settle in as they are heard.

items.name: pull-to-cursor
items.title: Pull Toward Cursor
items.description: Letters lean toward the cursor like a magnet.

items.name: redact-reveal
items.title: Redact and Reveal
items.description: Black bars redact a line, then lift to reveal the next.

items.name: ripple-to-still
items.title: Ripple to Still
items.description: Text ripples like water, then settles.

items.name: rolling-word
items.title: Rolling Word
items.description: One word rolls to the next like a drum.

items.name: rust-text
items.title: Rust Text
items.description: Brushed steel type that rusts while you watch and flakes away, polished back to a shine wherever the pointer passes.

items.name: scatter-text
items.title: Scatter Text
items.description: Phrases shatter into particles that regroup into the next phrase.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Letters resolve from random characters out of a soft blur, one after another.

items.name: scramble-to-word
items.title: Scramble to Word
items.description: A split-flap board scrambles to the next word.

items.name: scroll-highlight
items.title: Scroll to Highlight
items.description: Words light up as you scroll past them.

items.name: scrub-number
items.title: Scrub Number
items.description: A number field you drag sideways to change: a tick ruler opens out from the pointer with a magnified patch under the marker, notches every fifth tick, soft limits, faster steps on a quick drag, a finer step on Shift, typing on click and reset on double-click.

items.name: scrub-timeline
items.title: Scrub Timeline
items.description: A week-by-week ruler that swells under the pointer like a dock. Milestones pull the playhead in as you drag, ticks click past like detents, and a date pill grows into the milestone's card.

items.name: section-pill
items.title: Section Pill
items.description: A floating pill that names the section you're reading, with a ring for how far down the page you are, and opens into the full list, carrying the current title to its row.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A segmented control whose pill slides between options on a spring, squishes when pressed and can be dragged across the segments like the one on iOS.

items.name: send
items.title: Send
items.description: File upload that fills, then launches a paper plane out of the card.

items.name: share-menu
items.title: Share Menu
items.description: A share button that flips open into a pill of options, resizing to fit.

items.name: silk-cloth
items.title: Silk Cloth
items.description: A sheet of satin rippling in a light breeze, with a long sheen along every fold.

items.name: silk-vortex
items.title: Silk Vortex
items.description: Liquid glass streaming outward from a dark void: glossy folds mapped through a colour gradient.

items.name: siri-orb
items.title: Siri Orb
items.description: A glass assistant orb, black above and clear below, holding a twisting helix of light that splits into colour at the rim and winds wider while listening.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A skeleton measured from the real layout: one bar per wrapped line of text, a box for every image and control, one shimmer across them all, and a top-to-bottom reveal when the content arrives.

items.name: slot-letters
items.title: Slot-machine Letters
items.description: Each letter spins like a reel and lands on the next word.

items.name: smart-address
items.title: Smart Address
items.description: One address field that splits a pasted address into street, city, region, postcode and country, flying each word from where it was pasted into its own field.

items.name: soft-button
items.title: Soft Button
items.description: A plain button made with care: a gentle top-to-bottom gradient, a faint inner highlight and shade, and a crisp border, in primary, secondary and accent.

items.name: soft-clouds
items.title: Soft Clouds
items.description: A soft summer sky shot on grainy film, with billowing clouds drifting slowly on the wind.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small family of loading indicators (ring, radial, dots, bars, orbit) drawn on one grid with one stroke and tempo.

items.name: split-accordion
items.title: Split Accordion
items.description: Sections that sit together as one block. Opening one splits it away from its neighbours with an easing margin, rounds the corners at the break and reveals the answer; closing it merges the block back.

items.name: split-bar
items.title: Split Bar
items.description: Parts of a whole on one bar, linked to a list, with segments that slide to new shares when the data changes.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A primary button with a menu of alternative actions; the chosen one rolls into the main label.

items.name: split-panes
items.title: Split Panes
items.description: Resizable panes that follow the pointer exactly, snap into an icon rail when dragged past their minimum, and fold on their own when the container gets small.

items.name: status-dashboard
items.title: Status Dashboard
items.description: An infrastructure status screen with overall health, 90-day uptime per service, live latency, region health and an incident timeline.

items.name: status-stamp
items.title: Status Stamp
items.description: An ink stamp slams down: approved, in review, rejected.

items.name: stepper-button
items.title: Stepper Button
items.description: An add-to-cart button that reshapes into a quantity stepper in the same pill.

items.name: streak-calendar
items.title: Streak Calendar
items.description: An activity heatmap whose days lift under the pointer or arrow keys, with a tooltip that glides between them, a today cell that fills when logged, and a beat for a new record.

items.name: strike-todos
items.title: Strike Todos
items.description: A plain to-do list: checking an item draws a line through it, and unchecking wipes the line away.

items.name: swap-fields
items.title: Swap Fields
items.description: A from/to pair whose fields trade places along opposite arcs when you press swap, carrying their values with them while the slot labels hand over.

items.name: tactile-toggle
items.title: Tactile Toggle
items.description: A single switch whose knob squishes under the finger, drags like the real thing and springs home on release.

items.name: tactile-toggles
items.title: Tactile Toggles
items.description: A settings list whose switches squish under the finger, drag like the real thing, sweep a faint tint across the row as they turn on, and pause the rows they override.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A field that turns typed or pasted text into chips that pop in and shrink out, with Backspace to select and remove, arrow keys to move between chips and a nudge for duplicates.

items.name: terminal-demo
items.title: Terminal Demo
items.description: A terminal that plays a short session on view: the command types itself, output arrives line by line and a progress bar fills.

items.name: testimonial-carousel
items.title: Testimonial Carousel
items.description: One large quote at a time over a faint oversized quote mark, with a pill pager below; the frame eases to each quote's height, and it swipes and steps with the arrow keys.

items.name: testimonial-orbit
items.title: Testimonial Orbit
items.description: Customer photos on a slow ring around one quote; picking a face flies it into the middle while the quote cross-fades. On narrow screens the ring becomes an arch above the quote.

items.name: testimonial-wall
items.title: Testimonial Wall
items.description: Columns or rows of quote cards that scroll endlessly at their own pace, neighbours running against each other; hovering a lane stops it so the quote can be read.

items.name: theme-switch
items.title: Theme Switch
items.description: Switches the page theme: the sun pulls in its rays and is eclipsed into a moon while the new theme spreads out from the button.

items.name: tick-nav
items.title: Tick Nav
items.description: A section list on a ruler whose ticks swell like a dock under the pointer, sliding each label out with its tick.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Toasts that stack, fan out on hover, swipe away, and follow a promise from loading to done in one toast.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A quiet tooltip that waits before the first one shows, then swaps instantly between neighbours in a toolbar.

items.name: topographic-lines
items.title: Topographic Lines
items.description: Contour lines of a slowly shifting landscape, like a survey map; the pointer raises a hill the lines ring around.

items.name: tray-navbar
items.title: Tray Navbar
items.description: A navbar whose links sit in an inset tray, with a raised pill that slides to the current page. Links left, centred or right; zero to two CTAs.

items.name: tree-view
items.title: Tree View
items.description: A file and folder tree with folders that ease open, guide lines, a sliding selection and full tree keyboard control.

items.name: type-fighter
items.title: Type Fighter
items.description: A text field where each typed glyph flies in like a comet, or is written by pen.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Text typed with a human rhythm, mistakes included.

items.name: viscosity-menu
items.title: Viscosity Menu
items.description: A dot that pours into a menu panel like a drop of liquid.

items.name: voronoi-cells
items.title: Voronoi Cells
items.description: A living mesh of cells with waves of light hopping through it like signals across a network; the pointer lights the cells it passes.

items.name: waitlist-input
items.title: Waitlist Input
items.description: An email field with its button inside that shrinks to a spinner, then settles into a confirmation in the same space.

items.name: zoom-past
items.title: Zoom Past
items.description: Words fly toward you and the next one arrives behind.

items.name: squircle
items.title: Squircle
items.description: Squircle corner utilities with a paint worklet, falling back to rounded corners.
